articles.headline: Notice: Princeton Circuit quarterly meetings
articles.author: J. B. Hamilton
articles.summary: The quarterly meetings for the Princeton Circuit will commence at Princeton, N.J., on Saturday, April 16th [sic] inst., at 1 o'clock, P.M. The Quarterly Conference will convene, and at 8 o'clock preaching. Sabbath morning, at half past 8 o'clock, Lovefeast, and at half past 10 o'clock, sermon on the Eucharist by Rev. Wm. Moore of Trenton; at 3 P.M. ... at half past 7 preaching by Rev. W. H. W. Winder of Morristown, N.J. J. B. Hamilton, Pastor. March 30th-2t.

articles.headline: Special Notice: communion service to be presented to the Union A.M.E. Church, Burlington, N.J.
articles.summary: A communion service will be presented to the Union A.M.E. Church, Burlington, N.J., on Thursday evening next, the 18th inst., by Mrs. Fannie Sipple [VERIFY] and a committee of ladies from Philadelphia. A committee consisting of Rachel G. Davis, Hannah F. Jackson, Mary E. Cromwell [VERIFY], will meet the Philadelphia committee at the depot. The members of the several churches in Philadelphia and vicinity are invited. April 13 -- 1t.
people: presenter, with a committee of ladies from Philadelphia (Mrs.)

articles.headline: Special Notices: Frankford quarterly meeting; Woodbury Circuit; Frederica Circuit, Del.
articles.summary: Quarterly meeting at Frankford on the third Sabbath in April. J. H. Smith, Elder. April 13th -- 1t. The fourth Quarterly Conference of Woodbury Circuit will meet at 10 A.M. on the 20th inst. Quarterly meeting on Sabbath the 21st. The Rev. J. H. Turpin, Rev. J. B. Stansbury and other divines will be present. Love Feast at 9 o'clock on the 21st inst. Wm. W. Grimes, Pastor. On Monday, the 22d inst., Rev. J. H. Turpin will lecture to the young men at Woodbury. Admission 10 cents. Wm. W. Grimes. Quarterly meetings for Frederica Circuit, Delaware: Union church 13th and 14th April; Barrytown Church 21st; John Wesley Church 28th; Union Bethel Church May 5th. Isaiah S. Taylor, Pastor.
people: visiting minister and lecturer at Woodbury (Rev.)

articles.headline: Information wanted of James Watson, who left Philadelphia in 1861
articles.author: Jane N. Watson
articles.summary: Information wanted of my son James Watson, who left Philadelphia in 1861 and shipped to Boston [?] in the ship Lydia Scofield [VERIFY]. The last I heard of him was in 1862. He was then at Callao, Peru, and expected to sail for the Chincha Islands [?]. He was five feet [?] inches high, light complexion, ... Any information of him will be thankfully received by his mother, Jane N. Watson, Chester, Delaware County, Pa., care of William Murphy. April 13 -- 1t [?].
people: missing son; left Philadelphia 1861, a sailor

articles.headline: Advertisement: Social, Civil, & Statistical Association, lecture by Theodore Tilton, with the Black Swan
articles.summary: Concert Hall, Chestnut Street, above Twelfth. Social, Civil, & Statistical Association. Theodore Tilton, Esq., (Editor of the Independent, N.Y.) will lecture under the auspices of the Social, Civil and Statistical Association, on Monday evening, April 15, 1867, at Concert Hall. In addition thereto, the celebrated Black Swan will give occasional airs at the opening and closing of the lecture. Tickets admitting a gentleman and lady, 50 cents; single admission 25 [?] cents. Tickets at Trumpler's Music Store, S. E. corner Seventh and Chestnut, and at the door.

events.name: Bethel A.M.E. Church and the M. W. Grand Lodge A. Y. M. of Pennsylvania -- exchange of presentations
events.location: Philadelphia (Bethel A.M.E. Church and the Grand Lodge)
events.description: Quite recently the M. W. Grand Lodge A. Y. M. for the State of Pennsylvania presented to Bethel A.M.E. Church a handsome silver Communion Service. On Tuesday, March 26th, the Trustees and Stewards of Bethel Church made a return presentation to the Grand Lodge, consisting of a handsome Bible, Gavel, and silver Square and Compass, with a written declaration of Christian friendship, enclosed in a beautifully carved walnut frame, bearing the signature of the Pastor, Rev. J. Hollen, the Treasurer, Rev. S. Smith, the Secretary, Mr. L. R. Seymour, and those of the Trustees and Stewards. The design and execution of the Declaration was by the artist Mr. W. B. Jones, of 616 Pine St. The testimonial was presented by Mr. Abram Flrid [VERIFY; probably Field], and received by Rev. Theo. D. Miller, G. C. Addresses were also delivered by Rev. Jas. Lynch, Nathaniel L. Durham, W. G. M., and others.
attendees: received it; G. C. of the Grand Lodge (Rev.)
speaker; W. G. M. (Worshipful Grand Master)

events.name: Central Presbyterian Church Sabbath-school -- anniversary
events.description: The Anniversary of the Sabbath-school of the Central Presbyterian Church was held on Wednesday evening of last week (Mar 27). Recitations, dialogues and singing before a large audience. Mr. J. L. Freeman, the musical conductor, was ably assisted by Misses Davis and McKee. 'Household Economy', a dialogue, was well rendered by two scholars. A poem, 'The Return of the Regiment', was recited by Miss Julia Jones. A recitation [?], 'The Wind and Harp', merited much praise. The singing of the choruses by the school was excellent.
attendees: scholar, recited 'The Return of the Regiment' (Miss)

events.name: A.M.E. Zion Mission Church (Seventh St. below Dickerson) -- fourth quarterly meeting and union baptism at the Delaware
events.location: A.M.E. Zion Mission Church, Seventh St. below Dickerson, Philadelphia; baptism at the Delaware River, foot of Moore St.
events.description: The Fourth Quarterly meeting of the A.M.E. Zion Mission Church, Seventh St., below Dickerson, Philadelphia, to be held Sabbath, April 14th. A union Baptism in the morning: the candidates meet at the Church at 8 1/2 o'clock, to proceed to the Delaware River, foot of Moore St. Candidates are expected from Union and Wesley A.M.E. Churches [plain 'Wesley A.M.E.': Little Wesley lane, flagged]. Preaching at 10 1/2 A.M. by Rev. William Watson, 3 o'clock by Rev. James Hollen. Rev. R. P. Gibbs and other ministers of the city will be present. This meeting closes the last quarter of this Conference year. Love Feast, Monday evening 15th inst. T. Gould, Pastor. April 6th 2t. (Procession of candidates from the church to the river: parades/processions topic.)
